tweet.text:
Had Claude audit the token spend across ~850 agent runs on a large codebase I'm building (5.2B tokens).

 - 30% went on agent start-up: every agent loaded every tool, plugin and connector before doing anything
 - 88% was spent on calls with more than 100k tokens of context: agents were running for far too long
 - cache rewrites after idle gaps cost 155M more

Fixex: lean, role-specific agents (a test runner now starts at 8k instead of 34k), hand-over at 100k, plugins and connectors I don't use turned off, and a workflow that enforces all of it.

Target: half the tokens.
